name: Mussels in Spicy Sauce with Cheese-Filled Garlic Bread Sticks

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with foil and apply cooking spray.
Mince garlic and parsley. Place in a saucepan with the butter and melt over medium heat. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 clove garlic
1 tbsp Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
4 tbsp salted butter

instructions.primary_message: Unroll dough on a lightly floured surface. Cut the dough in half lengthwise, and then cut into quarters, to yield 8 small rectangles.
Top each rectangle with a mozzarella stick. Roll dough over cheese stick and tightly pinch the seams closed. Place on prepared baking sheet 2-inches apart. Repeat with remaining bread sticks.
Brush tops of each bread stick with butter mixture. Reserve remaining butter mixture.
Sprinkle cheese on top of each bread stick.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Bake for 12 - 15 minutes, until golden brown. Brush remaining butter mixture over the hot bread sticks.
Prepare mussels in a spicy sauce per package instructions and serve with warm cheese-filled garlic bread sticks.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (454 g) pkg mussels in a spicy sauce
